text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off. When I dropped by the Horse 
Girl shop――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
These are――fans for cheering... There 
is――a wide variety.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! There are ones making 
requests, ones conveying love, the 
variations are truly infinite...
choice_data_list: Hey, are you looking at fan merch?
Hey, are you looking at fan merch?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am――learning how to cheer at lives.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A junior――asked me for guidance. Her live 
performance――is soon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But――she gets stage fright. I want her――to 
get used to the environment during 
rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So, I will be――the audience. In other 
words――a simulation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I heard Digital――is skilled at cheering at 
lives. Therefore, I am asking for――her 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! Unworthy as I am, Agnes Digital 
will assist with all my heart and soul!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's practice call-and-response 
chants! Please follow along after me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: More! Kyun-kyun! Deliver it! Haaaai!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: More――...kyun-kyun. Deliver it――...hai.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Is it, like this?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*...... Th-That's pretty good! Next 
chant, coming right up――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So good!! So precious!! Our 
Goddessssss~~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...YOKIMI――TOUTOMI...? 
Our――...Goddess――...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Whoaaah...! Kris S-san waving a penlight, 
what an ultra-rare sight for sore eyes!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......? If it is inadequate――do not 
hesitate to point it out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-It's totally fine...! Though maybe 
relaxing your shoulders a bit more would 
help...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so came the day of the rehearsal. 
Curious, I dropped by the stage, and...
choice_data_list: How is Kris S's cheering going?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...! Please take a look at that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: More――kyun-kyun――! Deliver it――hai――!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――YOKIMI――TOUTOMI――! Our――Goddess――!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What do you think?! Her level has 
skyrocketed, right?! She's putting her 
entire body into the calls now, isn't 
she?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
This is truly a masterpiece wrought by 
love for her kouhai!! Ahh, the sheer 
blessedness...!!
choice_data_list: Ah, that girl looked at Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now is the time, Kris S-san!! Hit her with 
that finishing move――!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Fuwa, fuwa-fuwa-fuwa――! Foooooooooo――!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Your performance――was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Senpai's cheering filled me with 
courage! I'll keep this momentum going for 
the real show!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Digital――my thanks.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
N-N-N-Not at all!! It was your own 
heartfelt sincerity reaching her, there's 
no need to thank me...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Do not――be humble. The cheering you taught 
me――holds power.
choice_data_list:
Receiving that cheering would definitely 
give anyone energy!
I want to master the art of cheering too.
I want to master the art of cheering too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Do not――be humble. The cheering you taught 
me――holds power.
choice_data_list:
Receiving that cheering would definitely 
give anyone energy!
I want to master the art of cheering too.
I want to master the art of cheering too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Kris S-san's cheers are so 
intensely earnest that they penetrate 
right into your very core! I relate so 
deeply~~!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Penetrates... Hmm. Then, once again――I 
dedicate this to Digital.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
............Fuwa, fuwa-fuwa-fuwa――...! 
De-ji-TAAA――N...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Thanks――ARIGATO――...! De-ji-TAAA――N...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAHHH!!?? (*dies of blessedness*)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Then――will you train? Together――with me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Raise your voice! Channel your 
feelings――into your voice!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Your penlight waving is――too weak! Swing 
it――higher!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on a later date, I found myself 
doing special cheer training together with 
Symboli Kris S.
